statements.proposition: This change fixes a 'Cannot access startTour before initialization' ReferenceError in useTour.js.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: The change does move the startTour const before the useEffect. But at base startTour is only called inside the effect callback body (line 1146), not in the dependency array or during render. The effect runs after render, when the const is already initialised, so by JS semantics the described ReferenceError should not occur at base. The error could not be reproduced here (JS dashboard, no repro run), so whether the PR fixes a real error is unsettled.
